title: What Does the Bible Say About Sex Before Marriage? 26 Verses
description: What the Bible teaches about sex outside marriage: the Greek word porneia, Paul's letters, the Song of Solomon and grace for those who have failed, with 26 verses.
keywords: what does the bible say about sex before marriage
bible verses about sex before marriage
summary: The Bible teaches that sex belongs inside marriage. Its main word for sex outside it is the Greek porneia, which the World English Bible renders as sexual immorality: forms of fornication and sexual immorality appear 40 times in 36 verses of the WEB. Paul tells the Thessalonians that God's will is that they abstain from sexual immorality (1 Thessalonians 4:3), and the writer of Hebrews says the marriage bed is to be kept undefiled (Hebrews 13:4). The Bible also speaks of sex warmly inside marriage (Proverbs 5:18-19, Song of Solomon) and of full forgiveness for those who have failed (1 John 1:9, Romans 8:1, John 8:10-11). The verses below set out both the standard and the grace.

faqs.q: Does the Bible say sex before marriage is a sin?
faqs.a: Yes, as most Christians read it. The New Testament condemns sexual immorality (porneia) repeatedly and lists it among the works of the flesh (Galatians 5:19), and Paul tells unmarried people who cannot control themselves to marry (1 Corinthians 7:8-9). No verse uses the phrase premarital sex, so the teaching rests on these passages about sexual immorality and on the Bible's picture of sex within marriage (Genesis 2:24, Hebrews 13:4).

faqs.q: What does the Bible say about fornication?
faqs.a: Fornication is the older English word for sexual immorality. The WEB uses sexual immorality, the KJV uses fornication. Together they appear in Matthew 15:19, 1 Corinthians 6:18, Galatians 5:19, Ephesians 5:3 and 1 Thessalonians 4:3, among others. Paul says to flee it, because it is a sin against one's own body (1 Corinthians 6:18).

faqs.q: Can God forgive sex before marriage?
faqs.a: Yes. John writes that if we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us (1 John 1:9), and Paul tells the Corinthians that some of them had lived in sexual immorality and had been washed, sanctified and justified (1 Corinthians 6:9-11). Jesus told the woman caught in adultery that he did not condemn her, and to go and sin no more (John 8:10-11).

faqs.q: What does the Song of Solomon say about waiting?
faqs.a: Three times the beloved says not to awaken love until it pleases (Song of Solomon 2:7, 3:5, 8:4). Many readers take this as a call to let love ripen in its time. The book's other message is that love and desire inside a committed relationship are good, strong as death, and not for sale (Song of Solomon 8:6-7).
